name: Caelum IX Pressure-Form Dress Heel
description:
Caelum's IX heel uses a micro-pneumatic system in the sole to redistribute pressure across the foot in real time, eliminating the discomfort traditionally associated with high heels. The heel itself is a 9cm stiletto in polished titanium; the upper is heat-molded cultured python skin in deep emerald or midnight blue. Looks like a fashion weapon. Feels like a sneaker.

The shoe of Spire galas, boardroom power moves, and anyone who needs to stand for six hours without showing it.
functionality: Micro-pneumatic pressure redistribution for comfort during prolonged wear. Optional BCI-linked heel height adjustment (±2cm).
what_it_says: You are dressed for power and you are comfortable in it. That combination is rarer than the shoe itself.
story_hooks: A pair of Caelum IXs was found at a crime scene — the pressure sensors logged a full weight profile and gait pattern of the person who last wore them.
Caelum's BCI height adjustment feature has a known exploit. Someone used it remotely at a Spire event. The results were embarrassing for a very powerful person.
